(h) Comment: #8
Response: At present the source of funds to finance rehabilitation, within the text part V, are the only ones available. The project will however, be equipted with a full staff to assist individuals in their rehabilitation efforts. This will be included a "Financial Advisor" who is familiar with available methods of financing. This will tend to maximize the use of funds that are available.
